item.title: Delayed jobs report shows unemployment at 4.6%, jobs rise by 64,000
item.description: (Missouri Independent) – A shutdown-delayed jobs report released Dec. 16 showed an increase of 64,000 jobs in November, rebounding from a large loss of 105,000 jobs in October. Unemployment ticked higher to 4.6%, the highest since September 2021. item.title: Missouri lawmakers vow to tackle mental health backlog in jails
